insight: Rebranded from getrecall.ai to recall.it; lets you pick which AI model summarizes each saved item.
name: Recall
description: A personal knowledge base that saves, summarizes, and connects content from anywhere — articles, videos, PDFs — then lets you chat with it using the AI model of your choice. Capture from a Chrome or Firefox extension, the web app, or mobile, with spaced-repetition review to keep what you save.

modelSupport.notes: Choose which AI model summarizes and answers over your saved content.

edge: Goes beyond save-and-summarize: auto-links saves into a knowledge graph and resurfaces them via spaced repetition, so your library compounds.
